died.name: Enguerrand III, Lord of Coucy
died.cause: The French nobleman died at 60 years of age when, during a rough ride, he fell off his horse and impaled himself on his own sword.

died.name: Charles II of Navarre
died.cause: The contemporary chronicler Froissart relates that the king of Navarre, known as "Charles the Bad", suffering from illness in old age, was ordered by his physician to be tightly sewn into a linen sheet soaked in distilled spirits. The highly flammable sheet accidentally caught fire, and he later died of his injuries.

died.name: William Wycherley
died.cause: to his wife. He had married a much younger woman less than twelve days before his death
died.last_words: Promise me you will never again marry an old man.

died.name: José Anastácio da Cunha
died.cause: recorded by Domingos de Sousa Coutinho
died.last_words: Je craîndrais de ne pas mépriser assez la vie - some dreams of humanity qui me déchirent plutôt qu'ils me consolent...

born.name: Pope Alexander VI
born.last_words: All right, all right, I'm coming. Wait a moment.

born.name: Huldrych Zwingli
born.desc: priest and leader of the Reformation in Switzerland
born.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Kappel
born.last_words: Can this be considered a calamity? Well! they can, indeed, kill the body, but they are not able to kill the soul.

born.name: John Yates Beall
born.cause: hanged as a spy by the Union during the American Civil War
born.last_words: I protest against this execution. It is absolute murder-brutal murder. I die in the service and defense of my country.

born.name: Noor Inayat Khan
born.desc: GC, British spy in the Special Operations Executive
born.cause: prior to execution by firing squad at Dachau concentration camp
